name: pnk
description: PNK — billetterie punk, open source, sur Cloudflare Workers + D1

scripts.db:reset:local: rm -rf .wrangler/state && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.deploy: npm run check && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c wrangler.local.jsonc
